name: Menahem
overview: Menahem, son of Gadi, became king of Israel by violently overthrowing Shallum, who had reigned only a month (2 Kings 15:14). His reign lasted ten years during the time of Azariah king of Judah, marked by ruthless actions such as the brutal attack on Tiphsah because the city resisted him (2 Kings 15:16-17). Scripture records that Menahem did evil in the sight of the LORD, continuing the sinful practices established by Jeroboam son of Nebat, which led Israel into persistent disobedience (2 Kings 15:18). This account highlights the tragic consequences of leadership that turns away from God’s ways, underscoring the need for Christ-centered obedience and repentance.
